source_reconstruction.method: FIFAIndex-attributed rows rebuilt from the pinned ignored CSV; FUT and Online card vectors transcribed from the bounded source-helper page captures. This reconstruction followed an accidental overwrite of the evidence file; fields unsupported by the pinned CSV or captured source transcript remain unavailable rather than inferred.
source_reconstruction.missing_value_policy: Unsupported, unlabeled, placeholder, or unavailable fields are null/omitted; raw observed Online OVR and attributes above 99 are preserved. Only generated predictions are clamped to 1..99.
source_reconstruction.online_scope: Five FUT records retained; Online records contain the bounded captured profiles and attempts only. No whole-catalogue absence is claimed.
